GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (23 Nov 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN-1360)
APO 500
23 November 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
The following named Japanese will be apprehended as Suspected War Criminals and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date:
NAME RANK OR TITLE PERTINENT DATA
NAGAI, Kunio Lt (IJN) Chief paymaster and interpreter aboard Japanese cruiser TONE, 18 Mar 44. Probable home address: 27/2 Shinanomachi, Yotsuya-ku, Tokyo.
NAKAHASHI, Mitsuo Lt Cmdr (IJN) Chief medical officer aboard Japanese cruiser TONE, 18 Mar 44.
OTSUKA, Tadashi 2/Lt (IJN) Japanese cruiser TONE, 18 Mar 44. Probable home address: Aza-Abura Koga, Koshimura, Kikuchi-gun, Kumamoto-ken.
TAKASU, Shiro Vice-Adm (IJN) Commander of SW Area Fleet, Soerabaja.
TANI, Tetsuo Lt Cmdr (IJN) Gunnery officer aboard Japanese cruiser TONE, 18 Mar 44. Probable home address: 4 of 12 3-chome, Chihaya-cho, Toshima-ku, Tokyo.
YOSHIOKA, Keiji Midshipman (IJN) Japanese cruiser TONE, 18 Mar 44.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
